name: Silver Tongue
body:
School transmutation; Level cleric/oracle 1, paladin 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 10 min./level

DESCRIPTION

With the casting of this spell, you know exactly the right thing to say. You gain a +2 bonus to all Diplomacy checks made through the spell’s duration. The bonus increases by 1 per 3 caster levels, to a maximum of +5.
